source: Two user attachments in this request, copied unchanged.

fireProduction.intent: new sprite derived from visual reference
fireProduction.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: one standalone pixel art fire elemental enemy for a top-down 2D dungeon game. Reference image is visual style and subject reference only. Create a new recognizable flame-shaped creature with bright yellow core, orange/red outer flames, dark burgundy pixel outline, two small ivory eyes with dark pupils and a mischievous open mouth. No limbs, no weapons, no other subjects. Preserve chunky deliberate square pixel steps, limited 10-color palette, no soft gradients or antialiasing, like a 48x64 game sprite enlarged nearest-neighbor. Full creature centered, occupies 85% of canvas height, compact rounded base with pointed licking flames and a few tiny ember pixels. Transparent background with genuine alpha, no checkerboard, no text, no logo or watermark. Output a single sprite, not a sprite sheet.
